Sip&Pop

Privacy Policy

Effective date: September 14, 2026

This policy explains how Ayran Studio handles information when you use Sip&Pop. Sip&Pop does not require an account and Ayran Studio does not directly collect your name, email address, or contacts through the game.

Information stored on your device

Sip&Pop stores game progress and preferences locally on your device, including completed levels, earned stars, lives and their recovery time, daily-order progress, language, and sound settings. This information is used to run the game, restore your progress, and remember your choices. Ayran Studio does not receive this local save data.

Optional gameplay analytics

If you choose to allow usage analytics in the game, Sip&Pop uses Google Analytics for Firebase to process gameplay events such as level starts and results, scores, moves remaining, daily rewards, and rewarded-ad continues. Firebase may also process app-instance identifiers, device and app information, approximate location inferred from IP, and diagnostics. We use this information to understand level difficulty, detect progression problems, and improve the game. We do not attach your name, email address, or contacts to these events. Analytics is disabled until you make a choice, and you can change that choice at any time under Privacy & analytics in the main menu.

Advertising and third-party services

Sip&Pop offers optional rewarded advertisements through Google Mobile Ads (AdMob). If you choose to watch an ad, Google and its partners may automatically process information such as device and advertising identifiers, IP address, approximate location inferred from IP, device and app information, diagnostics, and ad views or interactions. They use this information to deliver and measure ads, prevent fraud, and comply with legal obligations. The exact data processed can depend on your device, region, consent choices, and Google's configuration.

Learn more in the Google Privacy Policy and on How Google uses information for advertising.

How information is used and shared

Local game data is used only to provide gameplay and save your settings. If you allow analytics, Google processes the analytics data described above on our behalf. Advertising data may be processed and shared by Google and its advertising partners as described in their policies. Ayran Studio does not sell personal information.

Retention and deletion

Your local game data and analytics preference remain on your device until you clear Sip&Pop's app data or uninstall the game. Data processed by Google is retained according to Google's policies and your account or device settings. To request help with privacy questions or data associated with the game, contact us using the address below.

Security

We limit the game's data use to what is needed for gameplay and the optional analytics and advertising services. No method of electronic storage or transmission is completely secure, but we and our service providers use reasonable safeguards appropriate to the information processed.

Children's privacy

Sip&Pop is intended for a general audience. We do not knowingly ask children to provide personal information directly to Ayran Studio. Parents or guardians who believe a child has provided personal information through the game may contact us so we can review the request.

Your choices

You can allow or disable gameplay analytics at any time under Privacy & analytics in the main menu. You can decline rewarded ads and continue without receiving the related reward. Depending on your region and device, consent controls, Android privacy settings, and advertising ID controls may also be available. You can remove local game data by clearing the app's storage or uninstalling it.

Changes to this policy

We may update this policy when Sip&Pop, its services, or legal requirements change. We will post the revised policy here and update the effective date.
